event.title: Battlefield Memorial March 2026
event.description:
As part of the nationwide America 250 commemoration, Coastal Heritage Society invites the community to honor those who fought in the 1779 Battle of Savannah, one of the Revolutionary War’s most pivotal conflicts, where approximately 800 troops were killed or wounded.

It is our privilege each year to remember their sacrifice and reflect on Savannah’s enduring role in our nation’s founding.

This event is free and open to the public.

Click Here to RSVP!

Battlefield Memorial March will lead guests through the footsteps of soldiers on that historic day in 1779. The march will begin at 9:00 am. All march participants will meet in the Savannah History Museum parking lot at 8:45 am.

After the march, a wreath-laying and remembrance ceremony will be held on Battlefield Memorial Park.

This remembrance event welcomes over 150 community members, elected officials, foreign dignitaries, and descendants of those who fought.

New this year: Sponsorship opportunities are available starting at $1,000.

Support Battlefield Memorial March

Title Sponsor – $5,000

  • Recognition in event remarks
  • All recognition benefits listed below

Event Sponsor – $2,500

  • Recognition in press release
  • Sponsorship acknowledgement post on social media
  • All recognition benefits listed below

Patron – $1,000

  • Logo placement in direct emails to over 6,500+ households
  • Logo placement on event landing page
  • Logo placement on event signage

Please email development@chsgeorgia.org to learn more or sponsor the march.

We hope to see you on October 9th for Battlefield Memorial March 2026.

event.description:
All aboard for a fun morning of books, crafts, and trains!

Join us at Savannah Children’s Museum on Sunday, November 15, 10:30-11:30AM for a special author visit and book signing with Kelly Young-Silverman, author of Hot Boiled Peanuts, and Rosalind and Maggie Bunn, authors of All Aboard, Georgia! and The Naughty List.

Kids can enjoy a peanut-themed craft inspired by Hot Boiled Peanuts, a train-themed craft inspired by All Aboard, Georgia!, and coloring fun while meeting the authors and celebrating their books.

Books will be available for purchase, or bring your own copies from home to have signed.

Included with admission. Free for Coastal Heritage Society members. Become a member: chsgeorgia.org/membership

Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Color Bash
event.description:
Following the runaway success of Glow-N-Fire — named the Pollstar Family Show of the Year — Color Bash takes the action to a whole new level, transforming the arena into a full-throttle collision of color. Vibrant paint-splattered trucks, bursts of color, and electrifying lighting turn every smash, and crash, into a vivid spectacle the whole family can see, feel, and remember.

When the mischievous Skelesaurus drains all the color from Monster Truck Island, it’s up to the crew of Rhinomite™, Mega Wrex™, Tiger Shark™, Bone Shaker™, and Bigfoot® to win it back — one massive stunt at a time, Every wheelie, jump, donut and freestyle run brings the color roaring back, building to a full-arena burst of light, sound, and pure Monster Truck energy. It’s the show you love, reimagined like you’ve never seen it.

“Color Bash is the most vibrant Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live experience we’ve ever created,” said Ken Hudgens, CEO, Family Entertainment Live. “We took everything fans love about the show — the massive trucks, the jaw-dropping stunts, the can’t-look-away energy — and supercharged it with color. It’s a brand-new way to experience the action live, and we can’t wait to bring it to families in [CITY] in 2027.”

For the first time in over four decades Rod Stewart performs live in Savannah Ga.

Sir Rod Stewart CBE is one of the best-selling music artists of all time, with more than 250 million albums and singles sold worldwide. His signature voice, style, and songwriting have transcended all genres of popular music—from rock, soul, and R&B to the standards and big band swing—making him one of the few stars to enjoy chart-topping albums in every decade of his five-decade+ career.
